events.title: Your Chat becomes your Crew - Multiplayer Twitch Mode & Next Fest Announcement
events.summary: Hey everyone :) Big news today on two fronts. Your chat becomes your crew \ We're building something new: Twitch Mode. Viewers can type !join in chat to take control of their very own crew member aboard the vehicle, live during the stream. Each colonist runs on its usual autonomous AI, but the viewer who claims it decides its job priority in real time, repair, man a weapon, haul resources, fight fires, whatever the moment demands. events.title: Door System & Vehicle Graphics Update
